headline: Peru Launches Auction of Petroperú Real Estate Assets Worth $9.6 Million
summary: Peru's ProInversión launched a third public auction featuring nine Petroperú real estate properties in Talara valued at $9.6 million, increasing total offered sites to 19 as part of state asset sales.
why: Petroperú is Peru's state-owned petroleum company, and government land sales reflect asset monetization efforts to support public energy finances.
